agent.session: a new session given only the prompt

prompt: Build an application from the OurPoker recipe: https://ourapps.app/recipes/ourpoker.txt
conditions: The session was opened in the recipe author's workspace; it read no files of the workspace's own knowledge. The person answered the agent's questions.

measured.method: OpenCode's per-message records, from the prompt to the end of the run; active time leaves out any gap over 30 minutes between messages (one: 35.2 minutes waiting for the person's answers)

results.ran: run locally and deployed to Cloudflare Workers; health check answers ok

results.tested: browser check: load, seat, deal, layout at 1280x800 and 390x844, no script error
results.ran: passed locally and on the deployed site

results.tested: installer built on the Mac; package check passes

update: A private GitHub repository was created and pushed; no workflows or releases (publishing and releases were answered no).
problems: propose-update in INSTRUCTIONS.md lacked --trusted; the agent installed into a new folder instead of updating in place.
The recipe text page was 830 KB, so the agent's fetch was cut off.
The server tests printed a workerd outputGateBroken message although they passed.
Nothing said what to do when port 5173 is taken.
The web worker's address was needed in deploy step 1, but its instructions came after it.

rating.mostHelpful: a short page for agents with the build steps, questions and slots first
